description: Read a remote text file and return its content. Binary files are refused (use ftp_download instead).

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes to read (default 262144, hard max 1048576).

path.description: Remote file path, relative to the server root.

server.description: Name of the configured server. Defaults to the configured default, or the sole server.

name: ftp_read
title: Read a remote text file
